feat: align FCC extension with real Flare Confidential Compute architecture

Per official FCC docs (dev.flare.network/fcc/overview):
- FCC extensions are Go HTTP servers in TEEs, NOT Solidity signers
- OP_TYPE/OP_COMMAND are bytes32 UTF-8 strings routed via
  TeeExtensionRegistry.sendInstructions()
- Replaced misleading CreditExtension.sol with:
  - contracts/CreditGateInstructionSender.sol (on-chain entry point,
    OP_TYPE CREDIT, OP_COMMAND EVALUATE/REGISTER_XRPL)
  - extension/main.go (TEE HTTP server: /action, /state, /info)
  - extension/handler/handler.go (credit evaluation + EIP-191 signing,
    mirrors vault's eligibility payload exactly)
  - README.md (full FCC flow + deploy instructions)
- Fixed bytes32 hex literal encoding in FDC Base.s.sol (use bytes32('XRP'))

security: bind FDC repayment to borrower XRPL address; fix FDC spec encoding

Security fix (dead field → enforced):
- borrowerXRPLAddressHash mapping replaces unused Loan.borrowerSourceAddressHash
- registerXRPLAddress() binds EVM borrower to XRPL r-address hash
- drawLoan() reverts XRPLAddressNotRegistered if unbound
- submitRepaymentProof() verifies resp.receivingAddressHash == registered hash
  → prevents repayment substitution attack (repaying to attacker address
  while reusing a valid memo commitment)

FDC spec fix (would fail against live verifier):
- attestationType is UTF8-hex 'XRPPayment' zero-padded, NOT bytes32(8)
- sourceId is UTF8-hex 'testXRP'/'XRP', NOT keccak256('XRP')
